output.population: 19 unique human participants (some repeated experiments), ages 19–43, recorded over 62 sessions during a continuous tracking task
output.summary: BIDS-formatted GX dataset combining high-density EEG with ECG, EOG and continuous behavioral vigilance measures during nine High-Definition transcranial electrical stimulation montages targeting frontal, motor and parietal regions with DC, 5 Hz and 30 Hz waveforms.
